en.muhajir-b-ali: 22. It has been reported by Abu Hamzah that

Abu Ja'far (a.s) said: Allah has some chosen ones amongst His creatures whom He spares from afflictions. He keeps them alive in well-being, sustains them in well-being, causes them to die in a state of well-being, shall resurrect them in well-being and admit them into Paradise in well-being.
